mapper.select: SELECT result_tb2.*, IFNULL(SUM(mrc.act_principal), 0) AS act_sum, IFNULL(SUM(mrc.usage_fee), 0) AS fee_sum FROM ( SELECT result_tb.*, IFNULL(SUM(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount), 0) AS cal_sum FROM ( SELECT mm.mbid, mm.id, cu.USER_NM, cu.FIRM_NM, mur.mb_product_code, mur.mb_status, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_date, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_expire_date, IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_termi_apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '-') AS mb_termi_apply_date, IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_termi_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '-') AS mb_termi_date, mm.fee_rate, mm.payment_rate, mm.sales_limit_per_case FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur, MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm, CBCI_USER cu WHERE mur.mbid = mm.mbid AND mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE AND mur.mb_status >= 06 AND cu.USER_NM LIKE '%${user_nm}%' AND cu.FIRM_NM LIKE '%${firm_nm}%' AND mur.mb_product_code LIKE '%${mb_product_code}%' AND mur.mb_status LIKE '%${mb_status}%' AND mur.mb_contract_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_contract_date < #{toDate} ORDER BY mb_contract_date desc LIMIT #{page}, 10 ) result_tb LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp ON mrp.mbid = result_tb.mbid GROUP BY result_tb.mbid LIMIT 10 ) result_tb2 LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc ON mrc.mbid = result_tb2.mbid GROUP BY result_tb2.mbid ORDER BY ${orderBy}

SELECT SUM(result_tb3.fee_sum) AS fee_sum, SUM(result_tb3.cal_sum) AS cal_sum FROM ( SELECT result_tb2.cal_sum, IFNULL(SUM(mrc.usage_fee), 0) AS fee_sum FROM ( SELECT result_tb.mbid, IFNULL(SUM(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount), 0) AS cal_sum FROM ( SELECT mm.mbid, mur.mb_status FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur, MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm, CBCI_USER cu WHERE mur.mbid = mm.mbid AND mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE AND mur.mb_status >= 06 AND mur.mb_contract_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_contract_date < #{toDate} ) result_tb LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp ON mrp.mbid = result_tb.mbid GROUP BY result_tb.mbid ) result_tb2 LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc ON mrc.mbid = result_tb2.mbid GROUP BY result_tb2.mbid ) result_tb3

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('06') THEN 1 END) as cnt1, COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('62') THEN 1 END) as cnt2, COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('63') THEN 1 END) as cnt3 FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur, MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm WHERE mur.mbid = mm.mbid AND mur.mb_status IN (06, 62, 63) AND mur.mb_contract_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_contract_date < #{toDate}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT mrp.mbid, '입금' AS status, mrp.calculate_deposit_date AS calc_date, mrp.calculate_deposit_amount, '' AS act_principal FROM MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp WHERE mrp.mbid = #{mbid} AND DATE_FORMAT(mrp.calculate_deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND mrp.calculate_deposit_date <= #{toDate} UNION SELECT mrc.mbid, '상환', mrd.deposit_date, 0, mrc.act_principal FROM MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_DEPOSIT mrd ON mrc.settlement_code = mrd.settlement_code WHERE mrc.mbid = #{mbid} AND DATE_FORMAT(mrd.deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND mrd.deposit_date <= #{toDate} GROUP BY mrc.settlement_code ) result_tb
WHERE result_tb.status IN (#{status})
ORDER BY result_tb.calc_date desc

SELECT DATE_FORMAT((DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)),'%Y-%m-%d') AS standardDate, cu.USER_NM, cu.USER_ID, mur.mbid, mur.mb_status, cu.FIRM_NM, cu.FIRM_ID, (SELECT csc.SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE csc WHERE csc.SELECT_CLASS = 'bizType' AND csc.SELECT_CD = cu.BUSINESS_TYPE) AS BUSINESS_TYPE, (SELECT csc.SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE csc WHERE csc.SELECT_CLASS = 'CBCI_SECTOR' AND csc.SELECT_CD = cu.BUSINESS_TYPE) AS SECTORS, DATE_FORMAT(cu.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FIRM_SETUP_DATE, cu.USER_PHONE, cu.FIRM_ZIP_CODE, cu.FIRM_ADDR, mur.mb_main_acc_number AS main_acc, mur.mb_demand_acc_number AS demand_acc, mur.mb_product_code, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_approval_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_approval_date, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_date, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_expire_date, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_termi_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_expire_date, mm.fee_rate, mm.payment_rate, mm.sales_limit_per_case FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON cu.USER_CODE = mur.user_code LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mm.mbid = mur.mbid WHERE mur.mbid = #{mbid};

SELECT @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM +1 AS rn, DATE_FORMAT(input_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS input_date, reviewer, eval_subject, title, detail FROM CBCI_EVALUATE , (SELECT @ROWNUM:= 0) rn WHERE eval_no = #{eval_no}

SELECT LIST.* FROM (SELECT @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM +1 AS rn, eval_no, DATE_FORMAT(input_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS input_date, reviewer, eval_subject, title FROM CBCI_EVALUATE , (SELECT @ROWNUM:= 0) rn WHERE object_no = #{mbid} ORDER BY input_date DESC)AS LIST LIMIT ${current_data}, ${data_limit};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_EVALUATE WHERE object_no = #{mbid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_EVALUATE( division, object_no, input_date, eval_subject, reviewer, title, detail ) VALUES ( '00', #{mbid}, now(), #{eval_subject}, #{reviewer}, #{title}, #{detail} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur SET mur.mb_status = #{status}, mur.upd_date = now(), mur.mb_termi_date = now() WHERE mur.mbid = #{mbid};
UPDATE CBCI_USER cu, MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur SET cu.USER_TYPE = #{USER_TYPE}, cu.UPD_DATE = now() WHERE cu.USER_CODE = mur.user_code AND mur.mbid = #{mbid};
